description:
Add clipboard support for copying text from the TUI.

Implement:
- Copy last assistant message (keybinding, e.g., Ctrl+Shift+C)
- Copy specific code block (select and copy)
- Use OSC 52 escape sequence for terminal clipboard access
- Fallback to pbcopy/xclip/xsel based on platform

Upstream: interactive-mode.ts clipboard handling
Depends on: terminal module
title: Clipboard integration: copy message/code blocks
